updater-remote.description: Allows the remote web UI (nora.systems, loaded in the main window) to check and install signed updates, and restart the app afterwards. It grants the three plugin permissions listed below and nothing else; the endpoints and the pubkey are fixed in tauri.conf.json, so remote content cannot redirect the update source. What it does NOT do is bound the application's own commands: those are not plugin commands and do not appear in any capability. Tauri refuses them to remote origins that have no explicit capability for them, and since audit #8 each sensitive command also checks its calling window against commands.rs::LOCAL_WINDOWS, so the guarantee holds from both sides instead of only from the ACL.
